program2='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    splits = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(a) == len(b):
                splits.append((a, b))
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid):
            a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            b = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if len(a[0]) == len(b[0]):
                splits.append((a, b))
    first, second = splits[0]
    bg = Counter(v for block in (first, second) for row in block for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else bg for c in range(len(first[0]))] for r in range(len(first))]
'''
